anomaly_label: Decreased distillate flow to distillate receiver (V003)

evidence.observation: Before the disturbance, system pressure was 499.7 mbar, column differential pressure 0.6 mbar, and distillate/reflux flows 0.1/0.6.
System pressure abruptly fell to 284.284 mbar while column differential pressure spiked to 18.626 mbar and reflux flow fell to 0.026.
Buffer differential pressure rose to 7.119 mbar; reboiler and upper-column temperatures fell to 57.067 and 50.442 °C.
System pressure has settled near 300 mbar, but column differential pressure is -0.1 mbar and both distillate and reflux flows are zero; sustained separation operation has not been demonstrated.

args.missing_evidence: Pressure setpoint and protocol transition history are needed to distinguish an intended pressure change from a control disturbance; verify pressure/flow measurements and vacuum, valve, and heater commands to identify the cause. No composition measurement or separation target has been provided.
